title: Amazon Bedrock models
description: The Amazon Bedrock model each feature uses. The defaults are the models the stack was deployed with; a model chosen here is used instead until it is reset. Enable access to a model in the Amazon Bedrock console before choosing it: this page does not check access, and a feature whose model cannot be invoked reports the error when it runs.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes, to each summary, answer or key frame started after that; one already under way finishes with the model it started with.

summaryModelId.title: Summaries and meeting insights
summaryModelId.description: Writes the end-of-meeting summary, reads pasted meeting invitations, names speakers from what they say, derives the agenda, and answers questions over past meeting transcripts. Default: the BedrockModelId stack parameter.

meetingAssistModelId.title: Meeting assistant
meetingAssistModelId.description: Answers in the meeting assistant chat, for the voice assistant's lookups and for questions typed in the meeting chat, and runs the troubleshooting agent. It answers mid-meeting, so time to the first word matters more here than for summaries. Default: the MeetingAssistServiceBedrockModelID stack parameter.

knowledgeBaseModelId.title: Meeting assistant knowledge bases
knowledgeBaseModelId.description: Writes the answer the document-search and past-meeting-search tools return from what they retrieve. Only models verified to work with a Bedrock knowledge base are offered. Default: the MeetingAssistKnowledgeBaseModelID stack parameter.

keyframeTextModelId.title: Key frame text
keyframeTextModelId.description: Reads the text of each key frame of the shared screen, once, when the frame is stored. Image-capable models only. Default: the KeyframeTextModelId stack parameter.
